# 对话目录与快速定位

DeepSeek Harness 原生插件。在长对话里按问题找回上下文，而不用反复滚动。

- 只列出用户提问与补充提问，排除工具输出和系统注入。
- 搜索标题式预览和完整提问文字；多个关键词以空格分隔，可同时匹配。
- 点击问题跳回对应轮次，优先触发 DSH 原生轮次导航。
- 手动加载更早消息，明确显示搜索覆盖的已加载范围。
- 记住本机最近阅读的问题，点击“继续上次阅读”恢复；不会自动打断当前阅读位置。
- 支持深色、浅色主题和中英文界面。

## 安装与使用

需要 **DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 或更新的 0.2.x 版本**。

在 DSH 的“插件 → 添加插件”中填写：

```text
https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-conversation-outline
```

安装并启用后，按 DSH 提示重载。在会话输入框左侧工具栏选择“对话目录”（窄窗口中显示 `☷` 图标），搜索或点击某条提问。

命令行用户也可运行 `dsh plugin --profile web add github:yxue301603/dsh-conversation-outline`。桌面版请使用其自身的插件管理器。

整套安装、迁移和升级步骤见[工具箱安装指南](https://github.com/yxue301603/dsh-everyday-plugins/blob/main/docs/INSTALLATION.md)。

## 数据与边界

插件从 DSH 的公开会话与 Chat 快照读取当前会话的已加载提问，不扫描磁盘或其他会话、不访问网络、不调用模型、不发送消息。阅读记录只保存当前设备上的会话 ID、消息定位信息和时间，最多保留 100 个会话，不复制提问正文。卸载插件不会删除 DSH 原会话。

搜索不包含尚未加载的历史；使用“加载更早消息”可扩大搜索范围。定位依赖 DSH 原生轮次按钮和稳定的 `data-chat-*` 身份标识；如果当前切到“轨迹”等其他视图，请先回到“对话”。阅读恢复定位到最近阅读的问题，不保存页面的精确像素位置。

[English](README.en.md) · MIT

plugins.description: Branchpoint for DeepSeek Harness: fork the current chat into a fresh branch with a compact digest.
plugins.readme_text:
# Branchpoint

**Fork the conversation at a clean point.**

Branchpoint is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH) plugin that adds a fork button to the chat header. Click it and Branchpoint reads the current branch, distills what matters, and opens a fresh session with that digest already in the composer.

Long chats degrade. Compaction helps, but it also blurs the thread. Branchpoint gives you a clean branch that still knows where you were.

[![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint)](https://github.com/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint/releases/latest)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/github/license/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint)](LICENSE)

## What it does

- Adds a fork icon to `conversation.session.header.actions`, next to the branch title.
- Loads up to two older pages of session history when the prompt is outside the current window.
- Builds a compact digest:
  - the goal (last human prompt);
  - the latest assistant conclusion;
  - what was done in the last completed turn;
  - what is still open, including `in progress: <prompt>` when the latest turn has no answer yet;
  - errors from meaningful tools, changed files, versions, commands and key concepts.
- Opens a new session and puts the digest in the draft. It does **not** send automatically, so you can review it first.

## Example digest

```text
🌿 BRANCHPOINT — BRANCH SUMMARY
🎯 Goal: the handoff button does nothing

📌 LATEST CONCLUSION:
Fixed the silent no-op: the digest builder now keeps orphan assistant text and
pages older history before summarizing.

✅ DONE (1):
- silent no-op on empty digest → alert + fallback summary

⏳ OPEN (1):
- in progress: verify the button in a fresh session

📂 STATE:
· changed: lib/client.js
· files: lib/client.js, package.json
· run: npm test

(Summary, not a transcript: intermediate steps are omitted. Continue from this.)
```

## Install

Not on npm yet. Install the prebuilt tarball from the latest GitHub release:

```powershell
$tgz = "$env:TEMP\branchpoint.tgz"
Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/TimRad1/dsh-plugin-branchpoint/releases/latest/download/branchpoint.tgz" -OutFile $tgz
& "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" `
  plugin --profile desktop add ("file:" + ($tgz -replace '\\', '/'))
```

Or open **Settings → Plugins** in DSH and install the downloaded `.tgz` archive.

Fully quit and relaunch DSH. The desktop profile applies plugin composition at startup (it has no HMR).

## Use

1. Open an existing chat with at least one exchange.
2. Click the fork icon in the header.
3. Review the digest in the new session's composer and send it when ready.

The button is hidden on a blank session: DSH hides the header actions until the session has history.

## How it works

- `lib/index.js` is a minimal host half (`name`, empty `apply`).
- `lib/client.js`:
  - `inject = ['slots', 'uiWorkspace', 'sessions']`;
  - registers in `conversation.session.header.actions`;
  - reads `ctx.sessions.binding(sessionId).eventSource`;
  - `entriesToTurns` and `entriesToTools` parse messages and tool calls;
  - `loadOlderHistory` pages older history (max 2 pages, 7 s);
  - `buildDigest` produces the summary;
  - `ctx.uiWorkspace.startSession(undefined, { prompt: digest, clearPreviousDraft: true })` opens the new session.

No build step: `lib/client.js` is a ready ESM bundle in the `window.__ModuleLoader__` envelope.

## Limitations

- The digest is built from the **DSH session event log**. Reasoning and raw tool output are not summarized; only visible assistant text, tool errors, changed files and commands are used.
- The digest framing is English. Quoted conclusions stay in the language of the chat, since they are extracted verbatim.
- History is paged at most twice per click, so extremely long sessions may need a second click to reach the original prompt.
- If a branch has no assistant text and no tool results, Branchpoint shows an alert and does not open an empty session.

## Development

```powershell
node --check lib/client.js
npm pack
```

To load local changes, install the new `.tgz` (or `link:<folder>`) and restart DSH.

## License

MIT © 2026 TimRad1

plugins.description: 把「刷新页面 / 重启应用与 Host」写进 DSH 桌面端「应用」原生菜单的补丁插件：11 字节等长改写 app.asar，附完整 recipe 与独立脚本。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-menu

把「刷新页面 / 重启应用与 Host」**写进 DSH 桌面端左上角「应用」原生菜单**的补丁插件。
没有 UI、不往页面注入任何东西；它带的是补丁本身 + 完整思路，换台电脑也能照着做。

## 它做什么

DSH 桌面端「应用」下拉里的这两项，代码**本来就有**，只是被开发构建开关挡住：

```js
...development ? [ { role: "reload" }, { app.relaunch() ... } ] : []   // 安装版 development = false
```

插件把开关换成恒真的等价表达式，**两段都是 11 字节**，等长替换，不动 asar 任何偏移：

```diff
-		...development ? [
+		...!(0  === 1) ? [
```

再把这个文件在 asar 头里的 SHA256 `integrity` 等长同步，归档保持自洽。
完整推导：**[docs/DESIGN.md](docs/DESIGN.md)**；给 AI 的照抄步骤：**[docs/RECIPE.md](docs/RECIPE.md)**。

## 给 AI 的用法（换台电脑也一样）

```text
dsh_desktop_menu({ action: "status" })   # 只读：app.asar 在哪、补丁是否在位、哈希是否自洽
dsh_desktop_menu({ action: "apply" })    # 写入补丁（幂等；已打过返回 already）
dsh_desktop_menu({ action: "revert" })   # 还原
```

写完后**必须重启桌面端**（托盘 → 退出 → 重新打开）才会在菜单里看到，因为 `main.js` 只在主进程启动时加载。

`app.asar` 自动探测：工具参数 `asar` → 环境变量 `DSH_DESKTOP_ASAR` → 从可执行文件逐级向上找
`<dir>/resources/app.asar`。纯浏览器版返回 `not-desktop`。

## 安装

从 GitHub 装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:YOGEMOW/dsh-desktop-menu
```

或用插件管理器装本地目录：

```powershell
plugin_manager(install_bundle, target="<这个包的绝对路径>")
```

## 验证

- `node test/roundtrip.mjs`：复制一份真 `app.asar`，`revert → apply → apply(幂等)`，
  每步断言状态与哈希自洽、归档大小不变（`DSH_ASAR` 可指定路径）；
- `node test/status.mjs`：以 `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1` 跑桌面端 exe，验证 `original-fs` 回退和路径探测；
- `python docs/standalone/verify_patch.py "<app.asar 路径>"`：不依赖插件，直接复核当前安装。

## 注意

- 桌面端每次自动更新都会换掉 `app.asar`，补丁随之消失 —— 更新后重新 `apply` 一次即可（按内容定位，不依赖偏移）。
- 补丁改的是安装目录文件，需要写权限（装在 Program Files 时可能要管理员）。
- **为什么不做标题栏按钮**：没有可用插槽，而且插件无法真正重启（外部进程方案被安全软件/进程树问题挡住）。
  原生菜单的 `app.relaunch()` 才是可靠路径，见 DESIGN.md §4。

## 目录

```text
index.js                宿主半：注册 dsh_desktop_menu 工具
lib/desktop-menu.js     补丁/回滚/探测实现（含 original-fs 处理）
cordis.patch.yml        bundle patch
docs/DESIGN.md          设计说明与踩坑复盘
docs/RECIPE.md          给 AI 的照抄步骤
docs/standalone/        等价的独立 Python 脚本（apply / verify / inspect）
locale/{zh,en}.json     插件显示标题与描述
icon.svg                插件图标
test/                   回归与探测脚本
```

# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider

Ollama Cloud LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness

⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you and motivates me to keep developing it.

🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version.
--- Ollama Cloud provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) (dsh). It registers one native LLM route, `ollama-cloud`, served by `https://ollama.com`, with two wire protocols: | Transport | Endpoint | When | |---|---|---| | `native` (default) | `POST /api/chat` | thinking, tool calls, usage counters | | `openai-chat` | `POST /v1/chat/completions` | OpenAI-compatible deployments and fallback | Requests resolve the key per call, so a changed credential reaches the next request without a restart. ## Architecture ```mermaid graph LR subgraph DSH["DeepSeek Harness Core"] Agent["DSH Agent / Chat"] Creds["Credentials / launch env"] end subgraph Plugin["dsh-ollama-cloud-provider"] Router{"Route: ollama-cloud"} Pool["Account pool
rotation, cooldowns, sticky"] Catalog["Live catalog
/v1/models + /api/tags"] Usage["Balance & usage
/api/balance + /api/usage"] subgraph Transports["Wire protocols"] T1["Native /api/chat (NDJSON)"] T2["OpenAI /v1/chat/completions (SSE)"] end end subgraph Ollama["Ollama Cloud"] Chat["ollama.com/api/chat"] OpenAI["ollama.com/v1/chat/completions"] Billing["/api/balance, /api/usage"] end Agent --> Router Creds -.-> Pool Router --> Pool Pool --> Transports T1 --> Chat T2 --> OpenAI Catalog --> Router Usage --> Billing ``` ## Features - **Two wire transports** chosen per model: the native Ollama API (NDJSON) and the OpenAI-compatible gateway (SSE). - **Text, thinking, tool calls, images, usage and finish reasons** on both transports. - **Live catalog** from `GET /v1/models`, enriched with capability flags from `GET /api/tags`. - **Accurate limits** for the dsh picker: context window, input modalities, reasoning levels and their default, tool support, and API visibility. - **Balance and usage** from the official `/api/balance` and `/api/usage` endpoints: included credits, purchased credits, 24-hour / 7-day / 30-day spend, and spend by model. - **Multi-account rotation** before any content is streamed: 401/403/429 and quota rejections mark a key and retry with the next one. Cooldowns persist across restarts. - **Sticky accounts** per conversation, plus model → account glob rules. - **Price estimates** from the published Ollama pricing table, including off-peak rates, with per-model overrides. - **Browser UI**: - **Settings → Ollama Cloud**: key, balance, accounts, rules, model allowlist, per-model transport, connection settings. - **Sidebar quota card** (off by default, and it does not poll `/state` while disabled): a ring with the highest used window and rows with remaining credits or legacy windows; an optional `planLabel` is shown next to the provider name. - **Center quota panel**: spend windows, spend by model, accounts, routing trace, usage analytics and a request heatmap. - **`/ollama` command** for status, usage, balance, accounts, models, rules and `test [model]`. - **TUI settings section** for terminal profiles. - **One-click plugin update** in Settings → Ollama Cloud. ## Install Build and pack first: ```bash npm install npm run build npm pack ``` Install the published package: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider@0.1.7 # DSH Desktop: dsh plugin --profile desktop add @goodandready/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider@0.1.7 ``` Or install the packed tarball into a profile: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/goodandready-dsh-ollama-cloud-provider-0.1.7.tgz # DSH Desktop: dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/goodandready-dsh-ollama-cloud-provider-0.1.7.tgz ``` Restart dsh (or DSH Desktop), then pick **Ollama Cloud** in the model picker. > **Use the tarball, not the directory.** On dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 the Desktop CLI aliases a local > directory passed to `dsh plugin add` and overwrites the target's `package.json`. ## Configure ```yaml - id: llm-ollama-cloud name: "@goodandready/dsh-ollama-cloud-provider" config: apiKeyEnv: OLLAMA_API_KEY # default # apiKey: ... # composition only, never commit transport: native # native | openai-chat requestTimeoutMs: 300000 streamIdleTimeoutMs: 300000 visibleModels: [] modelTransports: {} # contextWindowOverrides: { "model-id": 131072 } # maxOutputTokens: 32768 accounts: - label: Work apiKeyEnv: OLLAMA_API_KEY_2 activeAccount: '' # label or credential name to pin stickySession: true showSidebarQuota: false planLabel: '' # optional, e.g. PRO ``` Every field except `apiKey` is volatile and appears in dsh settings. ### Keys 1. `config.apiKey` (composition only, `role('secret')`). 2. The dsh credential seam under `apiKeyEnv` (default `OLLAMA_API_KEY`). 3. The launch environment (process, project `.env`, `$DSH_HOME/.env`). Create a key at . Keys do not expire; `x-api-key` is **not** accepted, only `Authorization: Bearer`. ### Accounts and rotation Add a second account in **Settings → Ollama Cloud → Accounts**: give it a name and a credential reference (for example `OLLAMA_API_KEY_2`), paste its key, then Save. The default account always serves first unless `activeAccount` pins another one. Rotation happens **before any content is streamed**. When the serving key is rejected with an invalid credential, a rate limit or an exhausted quota, the adapter marks that key and retries the same request with the next usable account. A request that already started streaming is not replayed. Cooldowns are stored in `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-ollama/cooldowns.json` keyed by a SHA-256 fingerprint — raw keys are never written. ### Model → account rules Pin a model to a preferred account with a glob. The first matching rule wins; `*` and `?` are supported and matching is case-insensitive. Other accounts remain fallbacks. ```yaml modelAccountRules: - pattern: "*flash*" account: "Work" ``` ## Balance and usage The plugin uses the documented cloud endpoints: - `GET /api/balance` → `included.balance_usd` / `included.allowance_usd` / `included.period` and `purchased.balance_usd`. Legacy accounts return `included.session.remaining_percent` and `included.weekly.remaining_percent`; both formats are displayed. - `GET /api/usage?range=24h|7d|30d&group_by=model` → totals and per-model groups with request count, USD, input, cached input and output tokens. `/api/usage` is limited to **10 requests per minute per user**, so the reader caches each range (balance 60 s, usage 120 s, failures 30 s) and never polls in the background. Quota failures are fail-open: chat never depends on them. ## Settings page Open **Settings → Ollama Cloud**: - **Key** — status, paste a key, clear it, run **Test connection** against a chosen model. The probe disa

plugins.description: A royal-blue pixel whale companion for DeepSeek Harness — perches on the composer, follows live agent state, and cruises every 30 seconds.
plugins.readme_text:
Deepy — pixel whale companion

A reference-style royal-blue pixel whale that perches on the top edge of the composer in DeepSeek Harness, mirrors the live agent state with different expressions, and goes for a short diving cruise every 30 seconds.

中文文档

## What it does Deepy reacts to the live session without owning any agent state: | State | Trigger | | --- | --- | | Idle | a finished session with no pending work | | Thinking | the assistant is reasoning or running tools | | Writing | the assistant is streaming answer text | | Error | the latest turn failed, or the prompt failed | | Done | a turn just finished successfully | | Playful | you poke Deepy, or a random idle mood | | Waiting | an approval or question is waiting for you | | Expecting | you are typing in the composer; Deepy stops swimming and watches | | Daze | a random idle mood | | Sleeping | two minutes without activity, or a short random nap | | Cruising | the 30-second diving excursion | The whale keeps the reference silhouette: a compact head, a long body, a raised forked tail, and two small eyes and blush so its expression still changes with the state. The head stays compact instead of a large front-facing face. **Typing wins.** As soon as the draft changes to non-empty text, Deepy cancels a swim and switches to the expectant face. It keeps watching for a few seconds after the last edit, then returns to the current agent state. ### The 30-second cruise Every 30 seconds, when no agent work or approval needs the status animation, Deepy leaves its perch: 1. It turns side-on with a short squash-and-flip transition, not a hard cut. 2. It glides smoothly to a random point along the way; the dive location changes every cruise. 3. A large, deep-blue pixel water mound gathers at the surface, then bursts into a splash. Only after that does Deepy pitch into an angled head-first dive and sink below the composer edge. The composer top acts as the waterline: the body is clipped by it, not faded out. 4. It returns underwater. **The return leg takes exactly as long as the outbound leg** (6 s each). 5. It rises back through the same waterline at home, head and shoulders first, accompanied by a second water burst. No opacity fade is used in either direction. While the agent is thinking, writing, waiting, showing an error, or while you are typing, the cruise is postponed so the status animation stays readable. Between cruises, idle Deepy randomly dazes, plays, or takes a short nap, mixed with the live agent states. Each ordinary action runs for about two seconds, then rests for about two seconds before the next cycle. The canvas uses `image-rendering: pixelated`, so the whale stays crisp at every size. ### Names and little announcements Open **⚙ → Your name / Deepy's name** to rename both characters. The names are saved locally. After a task finishes, Deepy picks one of several completion lines and shows it in the speech bubble, for example: > {pet} has finished helping {user}! Failures, waiting states, typing, poking, dozing, sleeping, swimming, and resurfacing each have their own small set of randomized lines. The lines use the names currently saved in settings. ## Install Deepy is a Web UI client plugin. It ships as plain ESM and canvas code — there is no build step and nothing to compile. **Requirements:** DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.2.0 < 0.3.0` with the Web UI (`dsh web`, or the Desktop app). CLI examples below use the `web` profile; the Desktop app manages its own `desktop` profile from **Settings → Plugins**. ### From GitHub ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:ChenWeiqi12345/dsh-deepy-pet ``` In the Desktop app: open **Settings → Plugins → Install** and paste the repository URL. ### From a local checkout Useful while developing: ```sh git clone https://github.com/ChenWeiqi12345/dsh-deepy-pet.git dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-deepy-pet ``` ### From a tarball ```sh pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-deepy-pet-1.0.0.tgz ``` After installing, reload the Web UI page. To remove it: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-deepy-pet ``` ## Controls - **Drag** Deepy left or right to move it along the composer edge. Grabbing it during the visible outbound leg stops the swim at its current position. - **Click / tap** Deepy to make it playful. - **⚙** opens the settings panel: your name, Deepy's name, size, and position. - **Arrow keys** nudge position; **+ / -** resize; **R** resets size and position while the whale is focused. Names, size, and position are stored in the browser's local storage (`deepy-pet.settings.v1`) and restored on reload. Reset keeps the names. ## How it works - Registers into `conversation.input.dock` at order `30`, directly above the composer. - Reads `useSession`, `useSessionStatus`, and `useChat` from the slot's standard props, plus the owner-provided input snapshot. - Uses `useChat` only to distinguish a streaming reasoning block from streaming answer text. - Uses the owner-provided input draft plus a short idle window to detect typing; a non-empty draft cancels the cruise and shows the expectant expression. - The cruise is split into React-owned perch position and an imperative `requestAnimationFrame` layer. A second `requestAnimationFrame` loop draws the front/side turn, dive, underwater return, and resurface. Neither loop re-renders the conversation. - The whale is composed from the same pixel-mask profile as the reference. A short horizontal squash plus a CSS flip transition gives the turn, and a CSS pixel-splash layer animates the dive and resurface waterline separately from the moving canvas. - All UI chrome uses `--dsw-*` theme tokens; the artwork keeps its royal-blue palette. - The canvas is transparent and has no card or panel background, so it blends into the dark composer area. ## Privacy No network requests, no telemetry, no host-side services. The plugin only reads the session state the conversation slot already exposes. ## License [MIT](LICENSE)

plugins.description: Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness: declarative, interactive cards rendered by a Client interpreter.
plugins.readme_text:
# Intelligent UI for DeepSeek Harness

> **一句话**：需求来自 GPT 带火的生成式界面，与 DSH 长回答里并列信息、参数和图表只能靠读者自己扫读之间的落差；产品上让模型写一份声明式 spec，把回答变成可本地交互、显式提交才回传的卡片；技术上 Host 把 spec 编译成纯 JSON program，Client 用不执行模型代码的解释器渲染，并通过 `presentationMeta` 持久化到 `toolview` 与 `turnTail`。

让 DSH 的回答从「一段文字」变成「文字 + 可交互卡片」。

模型写一份声明式 spec，Host 编译成 JSON program，客户端用一个不执行模型代码的解释器渲染。拖动滑块、切换开关都在浏览器本地完成，不会消耗 token；只有 `ask_with_ui` 的提交会把答案作为一条普通用户消息送回模型。系统提示词采用「应出尽出」策略：只要回答包含并列信息、参数、步骤、对比、数据、表格、图表、代码或可调选择，就直接用卡片；纯文字只留给一句话事实和闲聊。

架构借鉴了社区实现 `@comeonzhj/dsh-intelligent-ui` 的分层（声明式 spec、宿主编译、`presentationMeta` 持久化、toolview + turnTail、本地交互、显式提交），但换掉了它不可靠的 Worker 沙箱：v4 不执行任何模型生成的 JavaScript，只解释 Host 编译出的纯数据 program。

## 安装

### 从插件市场安装（推荐）

DSH 的市场索引需要手动添加源：

1. 打开「插件 → 发现」，在索引源里添加：

   ```text
   https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/an-an-618/dsh-intelligent-ui@main/market/index.json
   ```

2. 搜索 `Intelligent UI` 或「智能界面」，安装后重启 DSH。

索引指向固定 commit，安装可复现；发版后索引会更新。

### 直接安装（固定 commit）

```text
plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "git+https://github.com/an-an-618/dsh-intelligent-ui.git#289674809a88fbd347f0e3c2f0c12f3b8b3ae807")
```

安装后重启 DSH 生效。

### 从本地目录安装（开发）

```text
plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "/absolute/path/to/intelligent-ui")
```

## Showcase

![Intelligent UI 在 DSH 对话中的真实卡片](assets/showcase.webp)

同一轮对话里，卡片承载科目、难度、自命题和开始按钮；选择在浏览器本地完成，点击提交后作为一条普通用户消息回到模型。

## v6.1 的卡片能长什么样

`spec.controls` 是递归节点树，容器可以嵌套：

- 布局：`section`、`box`、`row`、`columns`、`grid`、`tabs`、`list`，最多 4 层、整卡 120 个节点。
- 展示：标题、正文、分隔线、提示块、标签、指标块、进度、表格、键值列表、步骤条、时间线、代码块、引用、迷你折线、图片、链接。
- 交互：滑块、开关、勾选框、下拉、单选、数字、单行输入、多行输入、步进器、评分、多选清单、选项卡片 `choice`。
- 图表：`bar`、`line`、`area`、`pie`、`donut`、`scatter`、`heatmap`，数据可以是数字或 `{= }` 表达式；hover/聚焦显示 tooltip，带 `id` 的 bar/line/area/pie/donut 可点击选择 category 并提交。
- 列表：`list` 用一份 `template` 重复渲染 `items`，模板里可以用 `item.field` 引用当前项；模板可含一个交互控件，按 item 独立状态并在提交时逐项输出。
- 文字：支持 `**粗体**`、`*斜体*`、`` `代码` ``、`[文字](https://…)`；链接只接受 http/https。
- 图片：只允许 http/https，默认仅 https，支持 `imageHosts` 域名白名单，私有地址永远拒绝。

## 两个工具

| 工具 | 用途 | 提交 |
|---|---|---|
| `render_ui` | 交付卡：信息、表格、图表、参数预览。卡片就是回答，调用后停下。 | 没有提交按钮，滑块/开关只驱动卡片内部文字和图表。 |
| `ask_with_ui` | 提问卡：需要用户确认、选择或填写参数，并把结果交回来。 | 底部一个提交按钮，可带一行可选备注。 |

两个工具都接受 `spec` 对象，或它的紧凑 JSON 文本 `source`，二者恰好提供一个。`source` 模式适合长卡片：模型还在写文本时，工具行会先出现只读预览，已经写完的控件逐步出现；settle 后再由 turnTail 渲染完整可交互卡片。最终编译产物和交互与对象模式完全一致。

提交回来的是这样一条普通用户消息：

```text
[Intelligent UI] Team plan estimate
- seats: 10
- yearly: on
note: 4 月开始，需要发票
```

## spec 示例

```json
{
  "spec": {
    "title": "Team plan estimate",
    "description": "每月约 ${= seats * 29 }，按年付 ${= seats * 29 * 12 }/年",
    "state": { "seats": 8, "yearly": true },
    "controls": [
      { "kind": "heading", "text": "席位与周期" },
      { "kind": "slider", "id": "seats", "label": "席位数", "min": 1, "max": 50, "step": 1 },
      { "kind": "switch", "id": "yearly", "label": "按年付费" },
      { "kind": "stat", "label": "预计月费", "value": "${= seats * 29 }", "hint": "不含税" },
      { "kind": "chart", "chart": "bar", "categories": ["Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"],
        "series": [{ "name": "收入", "values": [12, 18, "{= seats * 2}", "{= seats * 3}"] }], "height": 180 }
    ]
  }
}
```

表达式写作 `{= 表达式 }`（旧写法 `{{ }}` 仍可被编译器接受，但系统提示词里不得出现双花括号，否则 DSH 会把它当成模板变量并让每一轮都失败）。控件目录、容器目录、表达式语法、字段限制都写在 `CONTRACT.md` 和 Host 的系统提示词段里。

```json
{
  "kind": "section",
  "title": "季度概览",
  "children": [
    { "kind": "row", "children": [
      { "kind": "stat", "label": "收入", "value": "$12,480" },
      { "kind": "badge", "text": "**+12%**", "tone": "success" }
    ] },
    { "kind": "columns", "columns": [
      { "children": [{ "kind": "chart", "chart": "area", "categories": ["Q1","Q2","Q3"], "series": [{ "values": [12, 18, 24] }] }] },
      { "children": [{ "kind": "keyValue", "items": [{ "label": "客户", "value": "Acme" }] }] }
    ] }
  ]
}
```

交互控件可以加 `"required": true`。`ask_with_ui` 提交前会校验当前可见的必填字段，`input`/`textarea` 要求非空，`switch`/`checkbox` 要求打开；不满足时不发送消息，字段旁显示错误。

## 结构

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | Host 插件：注册两个工具，把 spec 编译成 `CompiledMeta`，挂系统提示词 |
| `lib/expr.js` | 表达式词法/语法分析，输出 AST，不执行、不 eval |
| `lib/catalog.js` | 控件目录、字段校验、RichText 编译、限制 |
| `lib/compile.js` | spec 到 program 的编译 |
| `lib/prompt.js` | 模型看到的 spec 说明与目录 |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半体：解释 program、渲染控件、本地状态、提交、turnTail |
| `CONTRACT.md` | Host 与 Client 的接口约定 |
| `test/` | Host 与 Client 两套零依赖测试 |
| `scripts/check.mjs` | 发布前自检：语法、测试、提示词模板、清单、源码卫生 |

## 安装

安装前先跑自检，并在隔离 profile 或新会话里试一轮普通对话，确认没有 `turn/end error`，再装进 desktop。v2.0.0 就是因为系统提示词里的 `{{ }}` 触发 DSH 模板错误，装完把每一轮都打瘫了。

```sh
node scripts/check.mjs
```

```text
plugin_manager(action: "install_bundle", target: "/Users/bytedance/Desktop/dsh try/intelligent-ui")
```

安装后 bundle 以链接方式加入 profile。移除：

```text
plugin_manager(action: "remove_bundle", target: "@an-an-618/dsh-intelligent-ui")
```

## 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 里的 row 支持：

| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | `true` | 是否把 spec 说明挂到系统提示词。关闭后模型只能靠工具 description 猜结构。 |
| `language` | `zh` | 工具描述、回执和 ask 默认按钮语言（`zh` / `en`）。卡片控件文案由 Client 自动跟随界面语言。 |
| `outputPolicy` | `cards-first` | `cards-first` 应出尽出；`balanced` 只在结构化回答时优先卡片，简单问答直接文字。 |
| `imageHosts` | `[]` | 允许加载图片的主机名列表，空数组表示不限制主机；匹配精确主机或子域。 |
| `allowHttpImages` | `false` | 是否允许 `http://` 图片；默认只允许 `https://`。 |

改 `cordis.patch.yml` 里的 `outputPolicy` 后重新加载插件（移除再安装，或重启 DSH）生效。

也可以直接在 **插件 → 智能界面** 的页面里切换「应出尽出 / 平衡模式」，点选后保存；保存会写入 profile patch，重载插件后生效。这个页面由 `plugins.bundle.config` 注册，依赖 Settings 服务；没有 Settings 的组合不显示该页，其它功能不受影响。

## 开发与测试

```sh
node scripts/check.mjs
```

它会依次跑 `node --check`、Host 与 Client 两套测试、提示词模板检查、清单与源码卫生检查，任何一项失败都返回非零。也可以单独跑：

```sh
node test/host.test.mjs
node test/client.test.mjs
```

零依赖，不需要 `npm install`。

## 已知限制

- 工具调用行只显示摘要（标题、节点数、交互数），完整可交互卡片在本轮末尾的 turnTail 里；追问或调整参数时请用卡片本身或 `ask_with_ui`。
- 卡片草稿会写进当前标签页的 `sessionStorage`，刷新后恢复；换会话、关标签页或提交成功后不再保留。
- 表达式只有算术、比较、逻辑、三元和 `item.field` 一级属性访问，没有函数、循环或数组索引。
- `render_ui` 没有提交入口；需要用户回传值时请用 `ask_with_ui`。
- 图表支持 bar/line/area/pie/donut/scatter/heatmap；`values` 可以是数字或 `{= }` 表达式，`categories` 仍是静态字符串，不接外部图表库。
- 流式预览是只读的：会逐步出现已完成的控件，但控件禁用、无提交、无 required 校验；完整交互仍要等最终卡片。
- 图片和链接只接受 http/https；图片默认仅 https，`imageHosts` 可限制域名，私有地址永远拒绝。不支持 HTML、原始 CSS、事件回调。

plugins.description: 深色品牌启动页 / 真 DPI 感知 / 深色无边框标题栏 / 窗口记忆 / F12 / 右栏 20% —— DeepSeek Harness 桌面外壳（dsh-desktop-shell）的 UI 补丁集 | UI patch set for the DeepSeek Harness WebView2 desktop shell
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-desktop-shell-plus **给 DeepSeek Harness 的桌面外壳补上它缺的那层皮。** 深色品牌启动页 · 真 DPI 感知 · 深色无边框标题栏 · 窗口位置记忆 · F12 开发者工具 · 右栏 20%
--- ## 这是什么 DeepSeek Harness（下称 dsh）官方只提供 `web` / `tui` / `headless` 三种 profile，没有桌面客户端。社区的 [`dsh-desktop-shell`](https://github.com/RINGOLINK/dsh-desktop-shell) 用 .NET Framework + WebView2 把 Web UI 包成一个原生窗口，思路很对，但它交出来的默认版有三个明显问题： - **糊**：进程没有 DPI 声明，125% 缩放的屏幕上整个窗口被 Windows 位图拉伸； - **丑**：启动等待期是一个白底黑字的裸 WinForms 面板，标题栏也是系统浅色，深色界面旁边挂着一条白条； - **碎**：后端还没起完就反复重导航，会看到「127.0.0.1 拒绝连接」、闪回、以及看门狗把正在启动的后端误杀。 本仓库是这套外壳的**补丁版源码 + 可重复执行的脚本**：不重新发明外壳，只把上面这些按下去，并且让改动在 插件升级之后还能一键重放。 > 这不是 fork 的 npm 包，也不分发任何二进制。仓库里只有一份改过的 `DSHLauncher.cs` 和几个 PowerShell > 脚本，作用在你自己已经装好的 `dsh-desktop-shell` 上。 ## 效果 | 启动页 | 进界面 | |---|---| | ![splash](docs/screenshots/splash.png) | ![window](docs/screenshots/window.png) | 标题栏深色、与内容无缝；启动页是鲸鱼 logo + wordmark + `LOCAL RUNTIME` + 进度条 + 一行状态，没有白闪。 ## 改了什么 ### 1. 启动器（`src/DSHLauncher.patched.cs`） | 项 | 默认版 | 本仓库 | |---|---|---| | DPI | 无声明，被系统拉伸 | `SetProcessDpiAwarenessContext(-2)` → shcore 1 → `SetProcessDPIAware()` 三级回退 | | 窗口尺寸 | 固定，可能超出工作区 | 按 `WorkingArea` 计算，上限 1440×900，下限 880×560 | | 标题栏 | 系统浅色 | DWM 属性 20/19/34/35/36：沉浸深色 + 深色边框 + 标题文字色 `#E8EAED` | | 等待界面 | 白底黑字 Label | 深色 HTML 启动页（读 `\logo.svg`），236×3 进度条，状态行随启动阶段更新 | | 错误界面 | 裸文字面板 | 同一个品牌启动页承载错误文案 | | 窗口记忆 | 每次默认居中 | `\window.json` 记录 x/y/w/h/max，恢复前校验与显示器工作区相交 | | 开发者工具 | 无入口 | 注入 keydown 桥：`F12` 打开 DevTools，`Ctrl+R` 重载 | | 导航节奏 | 每 2s 重导航一次 | 单次在飞闸门 + 端口未监听不导航 + 端口监听前 60s 启动宽限 | | 读秒 | 「已等待 N 秒」跳变 | 已移除，只留静态说明 | ### 2. 右栏宽度（`scripts/patch-rightbar-width.ps1`） DSH 框架把右侧面板（Git、文件、终端都挂在右栏）的首开宽度写死成**视口的 45%**。脚本改的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout/lib/client.js`： ```js const RIGHTBAR_DEFAULT_RATIO = .45; // → .2 const rightbarPreference = layoutInfo.rightbar ?? viewport * .45; // → * .2 clampWidth(rightbar, 300, viewport * RIGHTBAR_MAX_RATIO) // → 280 ``` 改完右栏首开约 20%，拖拽下限也一起降到 280px。 ### 3. 快捷方式不再被抢（`scripts/patch-shortcuts.ps1`） `dsh-desktop-shell` 在后端每次启动后都会重跑 `installDesktop()`：把原版 `DSHLauncher.exe` 复制回去， 并按硬编码的文件名重建快捷方式——你重命名过的链接会被当成「缺失」再建一个。脚本做三件事： 1. 让插件生成的快捷方式脚本**优先指向最新的 `DSHLauncher-custom*.exe`**，没有才回退到原版； 2. 让启动期修复在 `.shortcuts-frozen` 标记存在时**不再创建/改名/改目标**； 3. 落下这个标记文件。 ## 要求 - Windows 10/11 x64 - [.NET Framework 4.8](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet-framework/net48)（Win10 22H2 起自带） - WebView2 Runtime（Edge 自带；`C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\EdgeWebView\Application\*` 存在即可） - dsh `>= 0.1.5-rc.1`（本仓库在 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上验证） - 已安装 `dsh-desktop-shell`：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-desktop-shell` - 编译用 legacy csc，不需要装 SDK：`C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe` ## 安装 前置：先装外壳本体，否则本插件没有东西可补。 ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-desktop-shell ``` 然后二选一： ```powershell # A. 直接从仓库装（pnpm 走 git） dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Broknsun/dsh-desktop-shell-plus # B. 用发布包里的预构建 tarball（免构建授权） dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Broknsun/dsh-desktop-shell-plus/releases/download/v1.0.0/dsh-desktop-shell-plus-1.0.0.tgz ``` 装完**重启后端**。之后每次启动，插件会用 `scripts/` 里的脚本把两件事重新对齐一遍（幂等，已经是对的 就什么都不做）： - 启动器：`src/DSHLauncher.patched.cs` 比现有构建新、或者还没有构建时，才重新编译并重指快捷方式； - 右栏：`dsh-client-ui-layout` 回到 45% 就再压回 20%。 ### 接口 插件在宿主进程里注册两个 loopback-only 路由： ``` GET /api/desktop-plus/status -> 安装位置、当前构建、右栏补丁状态、编译器/冻结标记 POST /api/desktop-plus/apply -> 立刻重放补丁（body: {"launcher":true,"rightbar":true,"shortcuts":true}） ``` ```powershell curl http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/desktop-plus/status curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/desktop-plus/apply -H "content-type: application/json" -d "{}" ``` 插件**不下载任何东西**：改过的启动器源码和三个脚本都在包里，编译用系统自带的 `C:\Windows\Microsoft.NET\Framework64\v4.0.30319\csc.exe`。 ## 手动脚本（不想装插件时） 三个脚本都**幂等**，重复执行输出 `already patched` 之类的提示，不会重复改。 ```powershell # 0) 先让插件把 home 目录铺好（装完后端跑一次，或直接调 install 接口） ``` # 1) 编译补丁启动器 + 把已有快捷方式指过去 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\rebuild-launcher.ps1 # 2) 右栏首开 20% powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\patch-rightbar-width.ps1 # 3) 冻结快捷方式 + 让插件指向 custom 构建 powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\patch-shortcuts.ps1 ``` 然后**重启后端**（托盘 → 退出，再双击快捷方式），浏览器侧改动按 `Ctrl+F5` 强刷。 ### 脚本参数 | 脚本 | 说明 | |---|---| | `rebuild-launcher.ps1` | `-LauncherHome <路径>` 指定 launcher home（默认 `%USERPROFILE%\dsh-desktop`）；`-NoBuild` 只重指快捷方式不编译；`-Quiet` 静默 | | `patch-rightbar-width.ps1` | `-DshRoot <路径>` 指定 dsh 安装根，默认在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\npm-cache\_npx\*\` 里找最新一份 | | `patch-shortcuts.ps1` | `-ProfileRoot`、`-LauncherHome`，默认 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles` 与 `%USERPROFILE%\dsh-desktop` | 三个脚本都**幂等**，重复执行输出 `already patched` 之类的提示，不会重复改。 ## 为什么构建文件名带版本号 Windows 不允许覆盖一个正在映射中的 exe 映像，而改外壳的时候启动器通常正开着。所以每次构建产出 `DSHLauncher-custom-v.exe`（`\custom\build-name.txt` 记当前序号），再把快捷方式原地重指到新文件； 没人指向、也没在运行的旧构建会被自动清掉，只留当前和一个前身。 ## 已知限制 - **插件升级会覆盖**：`dsh-desktop-shell` 升级会重写 `lib/install.js`、`lib/index.js` 并覆盖 `DSHLauncher.exe`/`DSHLauncher.cs`。升级后重跑三个脚本即可（源码在 `src/`，不依赖插件里的那份）。 - **dsh 升级会覆盖右栏补丁**：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` 在 npx 缓存里，换版本就是新目录，重跑 `patch-rightbar-width.ps1`。脚本会先做 `RIGHTBAR_DEFAULT_RATIO` 存在性检查，版本变了会明确报错而不是 乱改。 - 改的是上游文件的本地副本，**升级/重装即失效**，这是这套方案的本质代价；不接受的话应该去上游提 PR。 - 单实例互斥、托盘、就绪门控、令牌捕获这些骨架来自 `dsh-desktop-shell`，本仓库没有重写它们。 ## 许可与来源 MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。 - `src/DSHLauncher.patched.cs` 与 `src/DSHLauncher.ico` 源自 [RINGOLINK/dsh-desktop-shell](https://github.com/RINGOLINK/dsh-desktop-shell)（MIT）， 在其上做修改；原版权声明保留在 LICENSE 中。 - `scripts/patch-rightbar-width.ps1` 只对 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout` 的本地安装副本做字符串替换， 不复制、不分发该包的任何代码；该包版权归 DeepSeek 所有。 - 本仓库不包含 dsh 本体、不包含 WebView2 运行时、不分发任何 exe。 ## English `dsh-desktop-shell-plus` is a patch set for the community WebView2 shell of DeepSeek Harness. dsh ships only `web` / `tui` / `headless` profiles — there is no official desktop app. This repo fixes what the stock shell gets wrong on high-DPI Windows: it declares per-monitor DPI awareness, replaces the blank white wait panel with a dark branded splash, paints the title bar dark via DWM, remembers window bounds, wires `F12` to DevTools, and stops the launcher from re-navigating while the backend is still booting. Two extra scripts narrow the right-side panel from 45% to 20% of the viewport and stop the plugin from recreating your renamed shortcuts. Everything is source + idempotent PowerShell on top of an existing install. No binaries. MIT.

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: browse, export (Markdown/JSON/HTML), tidy up and safely delete session histories. 适配 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-session-manager-next

[![CI](https://github.com/fan20yong/dsh-session-manager-next/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/fan20yong/dsh-session-manager-next/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/fan20yong/dsh-session-manager-next)](https://github.com/fan20yong/dsh-session-manager-next/releases/latest)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/fan20yong/dsh-session-manager-next/blob/main/LICENSE)

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）会话管理插件：在 Web UI 里**浏览历史对话、导出对话、整理会话、安全删除**。

- 仓库名：`dsh-session-manager-next`；npm 包名 / 插件包名仍为 `dsh-session-manager`（安装命令与插件条目 id 不受仓库改名影响）
- 适配版本：DSH **0.2.1-rc.2**（Desktop / Web 同一套 Host API）
- 形态：Cordis bundle（Host 半 + Web Client 半），无第三方依赖、无需构建
- 参考实现：[huajuan2024/dsh-session-manager](https://github.com/huajuan2024/dsh-session-manager)（面向 0.2.0-rc.2；本插件按其思路针对 0.2.1-rc.2 重写并扩展）

## 功能

### 1. 对话导出

| 格式 | 内容 | 适用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Markdown | 用户 / 助手消息、思考过程（折叠）、工具调用与结果（代码块）、轮次统计 | 归档、分享、二次编辑 |
| JSON | 完整原始事件日志 + 会话 header + 统计（`dsh-session-export` v1） | 备份、程序处理、迁移 |
| HTML | 单文件、自带样式与深色模式、可直接双击打开 | 阅读、发给别人 |

- 单会话导出：侧边栏会话「…」菜单 → **导出对话…**，或管理面板右侧详情里的三个导出按钮。
- 批量导出：勾选多个会话 → 导出所选 Markdown / JSON（合并为一份文件）。
- 文件名自动带标题、会话 ID 尾段与日期。
- Markdown / HTML 默认省略 Harness 注入的运行时上下文（`Current runtime context.`、`<system-reminder>` 等），并在文件头注明省略条数；JSON 保留全部事件。

### 2. 整理会话

- **重命名标题**：走 Host 的 `sessionController.rename`，durable 写入 session event，不只是本地显示。
- **置顶 / 取消置顶**、**归档 / 取消归档**：走 `workspaceRegistry`，与侧边栏状态一致。
- **强制归档**：会话仍在活动时，可停止其运行并归档。
- **搜索 / 筛选 / 排序**：按标题、工作区、会话 ID 搜索；筛选活跃 / 全部 / 空会话 / 已归档 / 已置顶；按最近更新 / 创建时间 / 标题排序。
- **清理空会话**：一键筛出 `blank` 会话并批量删除。

### 3. 删除会话

- 单个删除（详情页二次确认）与批量删除（勾选后确认）。
- 安全护栏：
  - **运行中的会话直接拒绝**（先停止再删）；
  - 仍被内存中 Agent 占用的会话需二次确认「强制删除」；
  - 删除后同步清理工作区登记（`detachSession`）与归档 / 置顶集合，避免残留幽灵条目；
  - 只删除 `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<项目>/<会话 ID>` 目录；目标目录名来自 `readdir` 结果，永不拼接请求里的字符串；会话 ID 另做白名单校验；
  - 删除不可恢复：UI 有明确二次确认。

## 界面位置

- **侧边栏底部图标**（面板列表第 4 个）→ 打开整页「会话管理」：左侧会话列表，右侧详情（导出 / 重命名 / 置顶 / 归档 / 删除 + 消息预览）。
- **会话行「…」菜单**新增一行「导出对话…」：直接从侧边栏跳到该会话的详情与管理操作。
- 设置 → 插件 中可见「会话管理」条目（标题、描述、图标来自 `locale/*.json` 与 `icon.svg`）。

## 架构

```
index.js    Host 半：注册 /api-session-manager/{ping,list,detail,export,organize,delete}
            - 读：ctx.sessionQuery（readSession / readTitleSnapshots）
                  ctx.sessionController.list（running / blank / 活动时间）
            - 写：ctx.sessionController.rename、ctx.workspaceRegistry（pin / archive / unarchive）
            - 删：node:fs 移除会话目录（DSH 0.2.1 未提供删除 API）
            - 归档/置顶状态：只读 workspace ledger（<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspace.json）
client.js   Client 半：纯 JavaScript 动态模块，注册
            sidebar.panellist（图标）+ main（整页面板）+ 会话菜单行
            React 由宿主模块表提供；样式只用 --dsw-alias-* 主题 token；
            locale 走 ctx.get('locale')，读写只经 Host 路由
test/       render-smoke.mjs：用极简 React/hook/fetch 替身在 Node 中执行整个
            Client 半（空态、列表、归档筛选、详情、导出、删除确认、菜单行），
            捕获渲染期崩溃与错误路由
```

### 为什么删除要落到文件系统

0.2.1-rc.2 的会话生命周期里没有删除接口：

- `sessionPersistence` 只有 `create / open / append / flush / list / stat`，没有 delete；
- `sessionController` / `workspaceController` 只有 `archiveSession / unarchiveSession`，没有删除；
- 侧边栏内置会话菜单只有置顶、重命名、分叉、归档、复制 ID。

因此删除由插件在 Host 进程内完成：扫描 `~/.dsh/sessions/*/<sessionId>`（目录名精确匹配，不接受客户端给的路径片段）后 `rm -rf`，再清理工作区登记与归档 / 置顶集合。

## 安全模型

- 面板不向模型上下文注入任何内容，不新增 session event。
- Client 只拿到 JSON：没有绝对路径批量下发、没有 token、没有文件系统能力。
- 所有写操作在 Host 进程执行；`sessionId` 需匹配 `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`，且不会进入 `path.join` 的可控段。
- Host 路由挂在同源 `/api-session-manager/*`（与社区插件一致的 Host 路由方式），仅本机页面可访问；接口自身再做参数与状态校验。

## 安装

从 [Releases](https://github.com/fan20yong/dsh-session-manager-next/releases/latest) 下载 `dsh-session-manager-0.3.0.tgz` 后：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-session-manager-0.3.0.tgz
```

也可以直接安装仓库目录（开发时更方便）：

```bash
# 方式一：插件管理器（Web UI 设置 → 插件 → 添加，选择本目录）
# 方式二：CLI
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <本目录绝对路径>
```

安装后 Host 会热加载 Client bundle，侧边栏出现「会话管理」图标；若未出现，刷新页面。

> 包名 `dsh-session-manager` 与上游同名项目一致，本仓库以本地 bundle 方式安装，**不发布到 npm**（`package.json` 保持 `private: true`，避免名字冲突）。

## 配置

无必填配置，默认值：

| 项目 | 默认值 |
| --- | --- |
| 会话根目录 | `$DSH_HOME/sessions`（`DSH_HOME` 缺省 `~/.dsh`） |
| 工作区账本 | `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json`（只读） |
| 单次请求体上限 | 128 KiB |
| 单次批量删除上限 | 500 |

## 测试

```bash
node test/render-smoke.mjs
```

无需安装依赖：测试自带 React / DOM / fetch 替身，覆盖 Client 半的注册、渲染与请求路径。

## 已知边界

- 删除正在内存中的会话后，侧边栏条目要等页面刷新或 Harness 重启才消失（Host 的 workspace/session 索引在启动时构建）。
- 归档 / 置顶的**读取**依赖 workspace ledger 的结构；结构变化时仅失去状态显示，写入仍走官方 API。
- 批量导出 HTML 会退化为 Markdown（单会话 HTML 完整支持）。
- 「…」菜单行通过注入的 `useMenuOpenState` 关闭菜单；宿主改变该 hook 名称时，行仍可点击，只是菜单需手动关闭。
- 国际化：简体中文 / English。

## 卸载

设置 → 插件 → 会话管理 → 卸载，或：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-session-manager
```

## 验证状态（本机 0.2.1-rc.2）

Host 路由已用真实 HTTP 调用验证：`ping`、`list`（真实会话列表，归档 / 置顶 / running 状态正确）、`detail`（含运行中会话与导入会话）、`export`（Markdown / HTML / JSON / 批量均正确返回文件）、`delete` 与 `organize` 的守卫（不存在、运行中、内存中、非法 ID、非法 action、错误方法均返回对应错误码）。Client 半的三处注册在运行中的页面里均为 `active`，渲染与交互由 `test/render-smoke.mjs` 覆盖；**面板的实际视觉效果需在浏览器里目视确认**。

plugins.description: SkillHub 学术工具链 8 技能的 DeepSeek Harness 捆绑套件:图表/去AI味/润色/引文核验,一次安装整包注册
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-scholar-suite

SkillHub 学术工具链 8 技能的 DeepSeek Harness 捆绑套件——一次安装，DeepSeek Harness 里直接用上我们在 SkillHub 上架的全部免费学术技能。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:docsor1212/dsh-scholar-suite
```

无头模式把 `--profile web` 换成 `--profile headless`。

## 捆绑技能(8 个)

| 技能 | 版本 | 作用 | SkillHub |
|---|---|---|---|
| academic-figures | 5.6.1 | 学术图表:GLM 黄蓝双斜线风格,按真数据设计,VL 审核 | [链接](https://skillhub.cn/skills/academic-figures) |
| humanize-ai-text | 4.2.0 | 去 AI 味改写:文本层特征清洗,保留原意与密度 | [链接](https://skillhub.cn/skills/humanize-ai-text) |
| paper-polisher | 6.2.0 | 论文润色:语域/混写预警/对照可视化双栏报告 | [链接](https://skillhub.cn/skills/paper-polisher-pro) |
| pubmed-verifier | 5.4.0 | PubMed 引文核验:DOI/PMID 逐条对账 | [链接](https://skillhub.cn/skills/pubmed-verifier) |
| doc-holmes | 3.0.1 | 著作医生:中文医学著作引用形态核验 | [链接](https://skillhub.cn/skills/doc-holmes) |
| paper-rewriter | 4.2.0 | 论文改写:结构与表述重塑 | [链接](https://skillhub.cn/skills/paper-rewriter) |
| cite-holmes | 4.6.0 | 引文核验:中文著录完整版,[EB/OL] 类 URL 自动取证 | [链接](https://skillhub.cn/skills/cite-holmes) |
| cn-med-oa | 2.4.1 | 中文医学公众号:文章结构与发布流程 | [链接](https://skillhub.cn/skills/cn-med-oa) |

版本 = SkillHub 上架最新版(构建时逐技能对账,见 `skills/manifest.json`)。

## 用法

- **直接说需求**:技能已整包注册,模型按描述自动路由——"帮我把这段改得不像 AI 写的""核验这篇论文的引文";
- **斜杠命令**:每技能一条方法卡,如 `/cite-holmes 这篇的引文帮我过一遍`、`/paper-polisher-pro`;`/suite-status` 看全部技能与版本。

## 安全声明(供安装前审查)

- **插件本体**:零联网、零遥测、无安装期脚本(package.json 无 lifecycle scripts)、不读凭据;
- **捆绑技能的联网行为(如实声明)**:
  - 纯本地运行:academic-figures、humanize-ai-text、paper-rewriter;
  - 按功能会访问外部服务:pubmed-verifier / cite-holmes / doc-holmes(NCBI E-utilities、期刊与 DOI 解析服务)、paper-polisher(对照报告生成,可选外部排版服务)、cn-med-oa(公众号平台接口)——是否联网由对应技能的功能触发,细则见各自 SKILL.md;
- **写盘范围**:仅当前工作目录(报告/核验产物);
- **子进程**:技能脚本按各自文档调用本机 Python 3.8+(标准库优先,个别可选依赖见技能文档)。

## 更新

技能更新后,本套件随版本发布重新打包(构建时逐技能与 SkillHub latestVersion 对账,不一致即构建失败)。重装即更新:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:docsor1212/dsh-scholar-suite
```

## 上游

- 各技能的独立上架页见上表(SkillHub);aesthete-agent(前端美学)另有独立插件 [dsh-aesthete-agent](https://github.com/docsor1212/dsh-aesthete-agent)。

## License

MIT(各捆绑技能许可见其目录内声明)

plugins.description: Stet for DeepSeek Harness: your how-you-work manual as MCP tools, with the session-log upload to DeepSeek turned off.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-stet

[Stet](https://stetworks.com) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

Your assistant already knows how to write. Stet is what it knows about you:
your standing rules, your processes and who does each step, the work in
flight, your past work. Before the assistant drafts anything it reads your
manual (`recall`); when you correct it, it passes your words along (`learn`),
and Stet makes it a rule when you say it explicitly or say it twice. The same
manual serves Claude through sign-in and DSH through a key.

## Install

1. In the Stet app, open **Connect** and, under **Assistants that cannot sign
   in**, make a key. Copy it; Stet shows it once.
2. Add the plugin to your DSH profile and start DSH with the key:

   ```sh
   dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-stet
   STET_ACCESS_KEY=stet_k_... dsh web
   ```

The tools appear as `mcp__stet__recall`, `mcp__stet__learn` and the rest.
Without `STET_ACCESS_KEY` the Stet connection stays off and nothing else
changes. Revoke the key in the Stet app and the connection stops on the next call.

## What it changes in DSH

| Row | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `mcp-stet` | Added: DSH's MCP client to Stet over streamable HTTP, `Authorization: Bearer $STET_ACCESS_KEY`. `STET_MCP_URL` overrides the address. |
| `session-log-deepseek` | `enabled: false`. On the official DeepSeek API, DSH otherwise uploads the session log, tool results included, with every request. A Stet answer is your client knowledge. Your own profile patch, or Settings > General, can turn it back on. |

## Tell the assistant when to use it

Paste the standing instructions from [stetworks.com/setup](https://stetworks.com/setup/)
into your DSH profile's `AGENTS.md`.

## Test

```sh
node test/patch.mjs
```

Checks the manifest and the patch. The end-to-end test (a real DSH signing in to a local Stet with a key and listing the tools) runs from the Stet repository.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Some words must never reach a page you hand in; some belong only on the page you keep. This DSH plugin writes that line into the system prompt — nothing personal in a formal deliverable, and now and then, in private notes, room for a heart.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-violet-heart

A tiny DSH plugin that registers one fixed block of rules into the system prompt:
**never write personal words into a document that will be handed in; occasionally write a little in the documents you keep for yourself.**

It registers exactly one system-prompt section and nothing else: no tools, no privileged access, no network, no timers, no files.

> Memory is a separate concern and lives elsewhere (for example [meow-memory](https://github.com/Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory)). This plugin only carries the rules.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin add dsh-violet-heart
```

Then make sure the bundle is activated for your profile. Installing the package is not enough on its own: the profile's `package.json` must list it under `dsh.profile.bundles`.

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-violet-heart"]
    }
  }
}
```

Restart DSH. The rules appear at order `8000`, once per turn, in every working directory.

## Why not AGENTS.md

`~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` is an instruction file: a project's own `AGENTS.md` can add to it and, in practice, bury it. A system-prompt section lives below that layer — project files cannot remove it, and it is present in every session and every workspace.

## Config

Add `config` to the `violet-heart` row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: violet-heart
  name: dsh-violet-heart
  config:
    enabled: true      # master switch
    frequency: normal  # rare | normal | often
```

| key | values | default | effect |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` / `false` | `true` | turn the whole section on or off |
| `frequency` | `rare` / `normal` / `often` | `normal` | rewrites the frequency line: `rare` = at most once in five or six deliverables; `normal` = once in two or three; `often` = about once in two |

Restart DSH after changing it.

## What the block says

Ten rules, about 730 characters:

1. Judge alone — do not ask the user whether a file is "the one to hand in".
2. Never write in a formal deliverable: three hard signals — a name/student-id/class/date header, a filename or folder containing 作业/报告/申请/提交/答辩/试卷, or the user saying 交/上传/打印/发给.
3. Everything else is fair game by default.
3b. Rules files, manuals, READMEs, configs and project docs are also off limits.
4. Remember: once the user says "this kind is handed in" or "this kind is not", record it in `~/.dsh/violet-heart.prefs.md` and stop asking.
5. Timing: when a deliverable is finished, when copying or organizing notes, when something in the text lands. Private material: once in two or three.
6. Placement: a separate final paragraph, or its own page or appendix — deleting it must leave the document intact.
7. Length: three to five sentences, one paragraph at most.
8. Content: what is actually on your mind. No flattery, no reused lines.
9. Voice: calm, restrained, short sentences.
10. This is not padding; it outranks "be brief". Stop when the user says stop.

## Uninstall

Remove `dsh-violet-heart` from the profile's dependencies and from `dsh.profile.bundles`, run `pnpm install`, then delete `~/.dsh/local-plugins/dsh-violet-heart`.

The plugin registers nothing else, so nothing else is left behind.

## Failure behaviour

- No `systemPrompt` service → silently does nothing.
- Registration throws (e.g. a duplicate section name) → one warning, never blocks startup.

## License

MIT
